title: QNX Global Hackathon
description: QNX's online hackathon on Devpost. Build an application, driver, library or component that runs on QNX 8.0 (free for non-commercial use through QNX Everywhere, QEMU or a Raspberry Pi 5 work), or a host tool that supports software targeting QNX 8.0. Five categories, $50,000 in cash prizes.
reward: $50,000 in prizes, paid in cash: $10,000 Grand Prize, $4,000 per category winner, $2,000 per runner-up, $1,000 honorable mentions, and two $3,500 bonus prizes
summary: $50,000 in prizes · closes Dec 15, 2:00 PM ET

eligibility.note: runs on QNX 8.0 (hardware or QEMU) or is a host tool that builds, tests or analyzes QNX 8.0 software

setup: join the hackathon with a Devpost account
get free QNX SDP 8.0 access through QNX Everywhere
each_time: a public open source repo that builds for QNX 8.0
a public YouTube demo under 3 minutes
rules: Submit on Devpost by December 15, 2026 at 2:00 PM Eastern Time. The submission period opened November 2, 2026.
Projects must be new (created November 2 to December 15, 2026) or existing projects significantly updated after November 2; explain the update.
Build something that runs on or targets QNX 8.0: software on any QNX-supported target including QEMU, or a host tool for Windows, macOS or Linux that builds, tests or analyzes QNX 8.0 software.
Pick one category: Robotics & Medical, Automotive & Mobility, Low-level Software, Developer Tooling & Host Tools, or Open-Source Contribution & Ports.
Ports go in a new repository created in the submission period that references the upstream by URL. Do not submit a fork.
The repo must be public on GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket with an open source license visible in the About section, and must show the project really builds for or runs on QNX 8.0.
Entrants must be above the age of majority. Residents of Brazil, Russia, Crimea, Cuba, Iran, North Korea and other sanctioned areas are excluded.
Individuals, teams and organizations may enter; more than one submission is allowed if each is substantially different.
A project can win one overall prize, one bonus prize and the Community Choice prize.
Winners are announced on or around February 4, 2027.
